758:t_1:492.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「...As of today the $$ジオン共和国$$ is dissolved too, and the nation called $$ジオン$$ vanishes completely...」

758:t_1:493.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$ジオン$$ will be reborn as a political organization. I wanted to welcome that moment together with you.」

758:t_1:495.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I'm no longer the princess of $$ジオン$$. But there must be something I can do, too...」

758:t_1:496.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「To find it, I intend to study under $$ハマーン$$.」

758:t_1:497.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We'll see each other again, right?」

758:t_1:498.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You came back to me. This time, I promise I will come back to you.」

758:t_1:500.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「$$マリーダ$$... I'm no longer a princess.」

758:t_1:501.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Be that as it may, the whole $$ガランシェール$$ team is employed as $$ミネバ$$'s bodyguards, you know.」

758:t_1:502.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Which is why I will accompany you.」

758:t_1:503.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Thank you, $$マリーダ$$, $$ジンネマン$$.」

758:t_1:504.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バナージ$$... You take care of yourself too.」

758:t_1:505.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The light you showed us will surely illuminate the world... I am grateful to you.」

758:t_1:506.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Please look after $$オードリー$$... after $$ミネバ$$, $$マリーダ$$.」

758:t_1:508.en:
$$バナージ$$
「There's no need to pretend anything anymore. So let's accept everything and start our relationship over from scratch.」

758:t_1:511.en:
$$バナージ$$
(I may never ride a $$ガンダム$$ again...)

758:t_1:512.en:
$$バナージ$$
(But that's okay. The future I choose from here on... I'd like everyone in $c to see it too...)

758:t_1:513.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「It feels kind of strange... To think that until recently, we were fighting side by side with that person.」

758:t_1:514.en:
$$ミコット$$
「If you're going to say that, everyone in $c is the same.」

758:t_1:515.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「True. ...But that's all in the past now.」

758:t_1:516.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「First I'll graduate from school. So I can think about what comes after that, too.」

758:t_1:517.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Let's all do our best, $$バナージ$$ and the others, too.」

758:t_1:519.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Thank you, $$オードリー$$... It was only a short time, but I was glad to see you.」

758:t_1:544.en:
$$ラクス$$
「...Thank you very much, Representative $$アスハ$$. Today's talk was very fruitful.」

758:t_1:545.en:
$$カガリ$$
「I'm the one who should thank you, Councilwoman $$クライン$$. Let's both do our utmost for the sake of the world to come.」

758:t_1:547.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Even in the new world, it looks like $$オーブ$$ will fulfill its role of linking Earth and $$プラント$$.」

758:t_1:548.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「$$クロノ$$ has been wiped out, but the remnants of $$ブルーコスモス$$ that it incited will probably remain a problem from here on.」

758:t_1:549.en:
$$メイリン$$
「Are you saying those people will start another war?」

758:t_1:550.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It's not unthinkable. We still can't tell what will become of the $$コーディネイター$$s' place in the world.」

758:t_1:551.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Even so, there's no way it's okay to attack people who are living their lives.」

758:t_1:552.en:
$$シン$$
「That's what we're here for. To protect the world from guys like that.」

758:t_1:554.en:
$$シン$$
「Getting rid of war is my fight, after all.」

758:t_1:555.en:
$$ステラ$$
「$$ステラ$$ will help too.」

758:t_1:557.en:
$$ムウ$$
「$$ステラ$$ has no aftereffects from the mind control anymore. She did plenty of rehab in $$オーブ$$.」

758:t_1:558.en:
$$ムウ$$
「So, $$シン$$... let her do what she wants.」

758:t_1:560.en:
$$キラ$$
「Look after her too, $$ルナマリア$$.」

758:t_1:561.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「Of course. One more handful on top of $$シン$$ won't be a problem.」

758:t_1:564.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Or would you rather throw a fit here and prove for yourself that you're a handful?」

758:t_1:565.en:
$$シン$$
「I wouldn't do that. I like to think I'm fully capable by now.」

758:t_1:567.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Then prove it with actions, not words.」

758:t_1:568.en:
$$シン$$
「Bring it on. I intend to keep fighting to protect this hyperdimensional world from now on.」

758:t_1:569.en:
$$キラ$$
「We feel the same way. So that we don't forget what we learned in the multiverse... in $c, let's do our best together, $$シン$$.」

758:t_1:571.en:
$$シン$$
(Beyond sorrow, anger and hatred, we learned to live together...)

758:t_1:572.en:
$$シン$$
(That won't change in the new world either. I'll keep fighting to protect it from now on, together with my comrades...)

758:t_1:573.en:
$$シン$$
(That's what I gained from fighting alongside $$カミーユ$$ and everyone...)

758:t_1:577.en:
$$香月$$
「You've gone and done it, $$勝平$$!」
